variance: Keep 115 highest Train variances after Train min-max range normalization; remove bottom 13 (approximately 10%); not raw-unit variance.
correlation: Greedy original feature order; remove a feature if abs(Train Pearson r)>.98 with any retained earlier feature.
stability: Keep 64 lowest mean absolute same-gas Train batch mean shifts divided by global Train SD; equal gas/batch groups, exclude gases appearing in only one batch.
supervised: SelectKBest ANOVA f_classif k=32 or64; fit y uses Train only.
model_settings: LR balanced C=.1; RF balanced100 trees; SVM balanced C1 gamma=scale. StandardScaler LR/SVM, RF unscaled; median imputer then selector then scaling/classifier.
ensembles: hard_full; hard_representatives; rank_equal; rank_svm2. Rank points5..0; weights(1,1,1) or(1,1,2); no probability averaging.
soft_voting: Not run: saved SVM probability=False; no time-respecting calibration validated.
primary: Equal-weight mean of three Fold macro F1 values
protection: Mean other-four F1 >= reference-.03 and each other-four mean class F1 >= reference-.10. Reference own-family full for family representatives; SVM_all globally.
ties: Within .005 primary: fewer zero-recall fold/class pairs; higher minimum recall; higher min(mean Toluene F1, mean Acetaldehyde F1); higher pooled fold macro F1; lower fold SD; fixed config order.
fold_dependence: Overlapping training ranges; no independent-replicate significance claims. Family selection followed by ensemble validation is not nested; optimistic exploration.
evaluation_gate: Freeze candidate, weights, selected model hashes before 9–10 predictions.
